theorem etcdstart.kmRevAt_log (γ : client.KMNames) (L : mvcc.Log) (r : Nat) (k v : GoString) (hr : r
    < List.length L) : client.kmLog γ L ∗ etcdstart.kmRevAt γ r k v ⊢ ⌜L[r]? = some [mvcc.Change.put
    k v (W64 0)]⌝

theorem etcdstart.kvOpStep_putKeyOp_changes (k v : GoString) (σ : KVState) : (kvOpStep (KVOp.put
    (client.putKeyOp k v)) σ).changes = σ.changes ++ [[mvcc.Change.put k v (W64 0)]]

theorem etcdstart.okFactKM_of_write (γ : client.KMNames) (k v : GoString) (σ : KVState) : ⊢
    client.kmWriteQ γ [[]] (KVOp.put (client.putKeyOp k v)) σ -∗ ⌜σ.rev + 4 < 2 ^ 63 ∧ kvLogOk σ⌝ -∗
    etcdstart.okFactKM γ { Rev' := W64 ↑(σ.rev + 1), Key' := k, Val' := v }

theorem etcdstart.kmRevAt_of_log (γ : client.KMNames) (L : mvcc.Log) : client.kmLog γ L ⊢ □ ∀ r k v,
    ⌜L[r]? = some [mvcc.Change.put k v (W64 0)]⌝ -∗ etcdstart.kmRevAt γ r k v

theorem etcdstart.kmRevAt_agree (γ : client.KMNames) (r : Nat) (k v k' v' : GoString) :
    etcdstart.kmRevAt γ r k v ∗ etcdstart.kmRevAt γ r k' v' ⊢ ⌜k = k' ∧ v = v'⌝

theorem etcdstart.kmRevAt_persistent (γ : client.KMNames) (r : Nat) (k v : GoString) : Persistent
    (etcdstart.kmRevAt γ r k v)

def etcdstart.okFactKM (γ : client.KMNames) (p : etcdstart.wrec) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜2 ≤ sint.Z p.Rev'⌝ ∗ etcdstart.kmRevAt γ (sint.Z p.Rev').toNat p.Key' p.Val')

def etcdstart.kmRevAt (γ : client.KMNames) (r : Nat) (k v : GoString) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ l, monoListLbOwn γ.ch l ∗ ⌜([] :: l)[r]? = some [mvcc.Change.put k v (W64 0)]⌝)

theorem etcdstart.checkOk_of_km (γ : client.KMNames) (trs : List etcdstart.wkv) (upTo : w64) (evs :
    List etcdstart.wev) (oks : List etcdstart.wrec) (hup : ∀ (p : etcdstart.wrec), p ∈ oks → sint.Z
    p.Rev' ≤ sint.Z upTo) : (etcdstart.collectOk (etcdstart.kmRevAt γ) (List.map etcdstart.pairOf
    trs) upTo evs ∗ □ [∗list] p ∈ oks, etcdstart.okFactKM γ p) ⊢ ⌜etcdstart.CheckOk evs trs oks⌝

theorem etcdstart.okFactKM_persistent (γ : client.KMNames) (p : etcdstart.wrec) : Persistent
    (etcdstart.okFactKM γ p)
